We will start with loading data from TCGA (The Cancer Genome Atlas). For the sake of this project, we'll work with breast cancer data. 

```{r}

# Submitting the "request"
clin_query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA", 
                       data.category = "Clinical",
                       data.type = "Clinical Supplement",
                       data.format = 'BCR Biotab')

# Downloading and reading data into R
GDCdownload(
  query = clin_query,
  directory = "GDCdata"
)

clinical.BCRtab.all <- GDCprepare(
  query = clin_query,
  directory = "GDCdata"
)

# Extract patient level clinical table
clinic <- clinical.BCRtab.all$clinical_patient_brca[-c(1, 2), ]

# Rename patient ID column
colnames(clinic)[colnames(clinic) == "bcr_patient_barcode"] <- "Tumor_Sample_Barcode"

```

```{r}
colnames(clinic)
```

```{r}
# Convert nodal status to text.
clinic$nodal_status <- as.character(clinic$ajcc_nodes_pathologic_pn)

clinic$node_group <- NA

# N0 categories indicate no regional lymph-node metastasis. This includes labels such as N0, N0(i-), and N0(mol-).
node_negative_mask <- grepl("^N0", clinic$nodal_status, ignore.case = TRUE)
clinic$node_group[node_negative_mask] <- "Node Negative"


# N1, N2, and N3 indicate regional lymph-node involvement.
node_positive_mask <- grepl("^N[1-3]", clinic$nodal_status, ignore.case = TRUE)
clinic$node_group[node_positive_mask] <- "Node Positive"


# Convert the grouping variable into a factor.
clinic$node_group <- factor(clinic$node_group, levels = c(
    "Node Negative",
    "Node Positive"
  )
)

# Check the available sample sizes.
table(
  clinic$node_group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)
```

```{r}
# Convert the survival columns to numeric values
clinic$death_days_to <- as.numeric(clinic$death_days_to)
clinic$last_contact_days_to <- as.numeric(clinic$last_contact_days_to)


# Create survival time.
clinic$survival_time <- ifelse(
  clinic$vital_status == "Dead",
  clinic$death_days_to,
  clinic$last_contact_days_to
)


# Record if death event occurred
clinic$death_event <- (
  clinic$vital_status == "Dead"
)


# Keep patients with known nodal and survival information. Removes NAs
node_survival_mask <- (
  !is.na(clinic$node_group) &
  !is.na(clinic$survival_time) &
  clinic$survival_time >= 0 &
  !is.na(clinic$death_event)
)
node_survival <- clinic[node_survival_mask, ]


# Examine group and event counts.
table(node_survival$node_group)

table(
  node_survival$node_group,
  node_survival$death_event
)
```
Notice a greater proportion of deaths ("true") for node positive patient. 

```{r}
# Create a survival object

survival_object <- Surv(
  time = node_survival$survival_time / 365.25,
  event = node_survival$death_event
)

# Fit one Kaplan-Meier curve for node-negative patients and another for node-positive patients.

fit_object <- survfit(
  survival_object ~ node_group,
  data = node_survival
)

# Create the Kaplan-Meier plot.

KM_plot <- ggsurvplot(
  fit_object,
  data = node_survival,

  pval = TRUE,

  conf.int = TRUE,

  # number of patients still being followed.
  risk.table = TRUE,

  xlab = "Years since diagnosis",
  ylab = "Overall survival probability",
  legend.title = "Lymph-node status",

  ggtheme = theme_bw(),
  palette = c("#2166AC", "#B2182B")
)

KM_plot
```


```{r}
saveRDS(

  "analysis_data/BRCA_clinical_processed.rds"
)
```
